scope: Private finite 257x257 center-pixel numerical probe consuming production modelThree/createScene, fixed Three 0.185.1 physical shaders, real GLB texture bindings and constant HDR loaded through the fixed @elftia/three-assets loadEnvironment/readVerified resolver. This is not a full Rocut Host/export/UI or Director transport acceptance.

directAndZeroSpecularRows.selection: Only three non-environment direct positives and zero-specular negative control. This attempt remains failed overall because its private HDR fixture bypassed package normalization and was too small for PMREM.

sharedLoaderIblAndFirstFiveNegativeRows.selection: Three IBL positives and roughness-red, metalness-green, data-srgb, lost-authored-uv, wrong-normal-forward-transform. Later unprecompiled renderer-reuse rows remain failed.

isolatedLastThreeNegativeRowsAndRepeat.selection: Fresh renderer/context per remaining negative control and repeat; not proof that the unprecompiled reuse path is stable.

independentOracle.method: Independent scalar GGX distribution, correlated Smith visibility, Fresnel, direct and hemisphere lighting, and multiple-scattering energy terms. DFG coefficients independently Hammersley-integrated with 65536 samples at fixed 16x16 support locations and bilinearly interpolated; renderer LUT numerical entries are excluded from expected values and used only for a separate CPU diagnostic.
independentOracle.lighting: Unmodified production white directional intensity3 at [3,5,4] and white/#303040 hemisphere intensity2; no shader or light substitutions.
independentOracle.output: Three NoToneMapping, SRGB output; readPixels center [128,128] in 257x257 drawing buffer.

hdrPrecisionBoundary.note: HDR Float input is not exactly equal to the theoretical power-of-two RGB. Expectations stayed frozen; the decoding difference fits the predeclared 2byte numerical gate.

unprecompiled.warnings: Texture-unit allocation warnings from index16; ninth frame activeTexture/sampler out-of-range.
unprecompiled.sourceCause: Fixed r185 nested PMREM rendering restores the outer render-entry texture counter after setProgram resets it, accumulating four sampler allocations per fresh environment.

rendererLifecycleControl.productAttribution: Existing Rocut ordinary/particle/liquid drivers already await compileAsync before render. The bypassed-precompile red is not a demonstrated defect in those current formal drivers. Director consumer applicability is separate and is not established by this index.

limits: Finite nonzero-specular dielectric/mixed/metallic cases only; no claim of all physical models or arbitrary glTF materials.
Constant environment validates energy/color/intensity, not directional lookup or nonconstant PMREM convolution.
Texture channel, linear data handling, authored UV transform and inverse-transpose normals are covered only by the listed finite combinations.
Selected green rows from failed batches are explicitly indexed; original failed receipts remain preserved and are not relabeled as globally passed.
No Host archive/export/UI/history acceptance, Director render-loop acceptance, or broad matrix rerun is claimed.
